schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: THE HEARTBEAT, and only that (ticket bae622881f03; Akien 2026-09-30: beat, report found devices, and the flags). Each beat it (1) checks its own .py mtimes and re-execs in place if they changed, unless COMMAND_DO_NOT_RESTART is set; (2) obeys the flags (COMMAND_EXIT stops it); (3) reports the devices it finds (a device is a shim + its component, per the bus charter); (4) calls nothing (ticket 164da559823d retired the per-device pulse calls) — spawning the pulse to its listeners, as separate processes it does not wait on, with no skip or overlap logic, is filed edge (b)'s work; (5) writes one JSON of what it did. Exactly two things listen to the pulse: messaging (the bus writes its ring to the db — Akien: "NOTHING in the system that should fire on the heartbeat execpt the messaging"), and the cairn device, which holds the only two clock uses — Akien's away windows ("Akien can say he'll be away from x to y times") and sleep. Each decides for itself whether anything is due. No probes ride the beat. A second loop exits while one is running and healthy.
why: Akien 2026-09-30: CC once made daemons for everything and could not shut them down, so the one loop is as simple as possible. "this is ENTIERLY an event driven system EXCEPT: Akien can say he'll be away from x to y times. and sleep." Every extra duty is a way for the one thing everything depends on to fail — measured 2026-09-30, a bytecode-staleness check restarted it 61 times on an untouched tree.
invoke: Run resident: `python3 -m cairn.devices.cairn.machines.ground_loop` (the cairn-ground-loop unit). Operator: `cairn groundloop status|start|stop|restart`. Stop: touch <home>/COMMAND_EXIT.flag or SIGTERM. Hold restarts while editing: COMMAND_DO_NOT_RESTART.flag in <home>. Prove: `python3 cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/test_heartbeat.py`.
entry: Fresh design. One process, one beat, one record; the two clock users spawned, never hosted.
state_and_history: compiled to state.json + history.json beside this charter
filed_edges: (a) ticket efb670ff1dd8 (in flight): loop.py and staleness.py deleted; bus_client and the web server hold a DeviceRoster instead of a private loop.

(b) DONE for the deletion (ticket 164da559823d): every per-device pulse file and beat_probes.py is gone and the loop calls nothing in-process; still open: the loop spawns the pulse to its two listeners.
(c) the cairn device's away windows and sleep check on the pulse — cast tickets' work (see the cairn device charter).
gates: proof gate (tester) — proofs/test_heartbeat.py, bare and under the tester. Done means proven and committed.
falsifier: RED on any of: (1) an own-file change not detected, or an untouched tree read as changed; (2) a changed own file not re-execing in place, or re-execing while COMMAND_DO_NOT_RESTART is set; (3) COMMAND_EXIT not stopping it with rc 0; (4) a second runner starting while one is healthy; (5) the record missing beat time, pid, mtimes, found devices or what it spawned; (6) the pulse reaching anything but the bus's ring flush and the cairn device, or the loop waiting on what it spawned; (7) the runner re-growing a bus, a shim, probes, pulses, staleness or takeover. Live horizon: the deployed loop beats with one pid and changed == [].
